Among Terminal 0.1.2-rc.2 is an acceptance candidate, not an approved stable
publication.

- Bind the current AppStream release to the actual DEB, RPM or AppImage version,
  including the RC suffix, while preserving source metadata and release history.
- Resolve a unique existing AppImageLauncher registration when its image is
  opened without GIO desktop-launch hints. Keep the global application identity,
  native desktop association and child-environment boundary unchanged.
- Exercise integration while the isolated GNOME Shell is already running and
  include opening the registered file itself in the desktop regression.
- Supply exact-size approved raster icons for AppImageLauncher's file thumbnails
  and reject transparent thumbnail output in the real integration check.

The approved square artwork and public UI screenshot remain unchanged. GNOME
Software's standalone-DEB card can still use package fallbacks; rich AppStream
presentation is a separate consumer path. No repository or signing key is added.
No host desktop registration is created implicitly for an unintegrated image.

Exact-candidate package and graphical acceptance remain required before promotion.
Published 0.1.1 and the existing rc.1 tag/assets are not replaced.
